import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
import lightgbm as lgb
import os

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
print("Loading data...")
train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

print(f"Train shape: {train.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test.shape}")

# Prepare features and target
target_col = "Cover_Type"
feature_cols = [col for col in train.columns if col not in ["Id", target_col]]

X = train[feature_cols].values
y = train[target_col].values
X_test = test[feature_cols].values
test_ids = test["Id"].values

# Stratified train/validation split for genuine hold-out estimate
print("Creating train/validation split...")
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X, y, test_size=0.1, random_state=42, stratify=y
)

print(f"Training samples: {len(X_train)}, Validation samples: {len(X_val)}")

# Convert to LightGBM format
train_data = lgb.Dataset(X_train, label=y_train)
val_data = lgb.Dataset(X_val, label=y_val, reference=train_data)

# Set up parameters for multiclass classification
params = {
    "objective": "multiclass",
    "num_class": 7,
    "metric": "multi_logloss",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "num_leaves": 63,
    "max_depth": 10,
    "min_child_samples": 20,
    "reg_alpha": 0.1,
    "reg_lambda": 0.1,
    "subsample": 0.8,
    "colsample_bytree": 0.8,
    "seed": 42,
    "verbosity": -1,
    "force_row_wise": True,
}

print("Training LightGBM model...")
model = lgb.train(
    params,
    train_data,
    num_boost_round=1000,
    valid_sets=[val_data],
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50, verbose=False)],
)

# Get best iteration
best_iteration = model.best_iteration
print(f"Best iteration: {best_iteration}")

# Validate on held-out set (genuine validation score)
print("Validating model...")
val_preds = model.predict(X_val, num_iteration=best_iteration)
val_preds_class = np.argmax(val_preds, axis=1)
val_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_val, val_preds_class)
print(f"Validation Accuracy: {val_accuracy:.6f}")

# Predict on test set
print("Generating predictions on test set...")
test_preds = model.predict(X_test, num_iteration=best_iteration)
test_preds_class = np.argmax(test_preds, axis=1)

# Create submission file
submission_df = pd.DataFrame({"Id": test_ids, "Cover_Type": test_preds_class})
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print(f"Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Submission shape: {submission_df.shape}")
print(
    f"Predictions distribution:\n{pd.Series(test_preds_class).value_counts().sort_index()}"
)
print(f"Sample submission preview:")
print(submission_df.head())
